Raghavan, Venkataraman. Śāhendravilāsa of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa (A Poem on the Life of King Śāhaji of Tanjore, 1684-1710). Tiruchi: The Kalyan Press, 1952.
person.note: He acquired the title vājapeyi due to the performance of the vājapeya yajña. (See Krishnamurthy, R. The Saints of the Cauvery Delta. New Delhi: Concept Publishing Company, 1979: p. 30)

He was brought over to Thiruvalangadu in mayavarum taluk of the Thanjavur district by Tryambakaraya, minister of Śāhaji. (See Krishnamurthy, R. The Saints of the Cauvery Delta. New Delhi: Concept Publishing Company, 1979: p. 30). This Thiruvalangadu near the Delta was a colony of the other (older, Northern) Thiruvalangadu near Chennai, Madras, (See Raghavan, Venkataraman. Śāhendravilāsa of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa (A Poem on the Life of King Śāhaji of Tanjore, 1684-1710). Tiruchi: The Kalyan Press, 1952: p. 36).

He was of an earlier generation to King Śāhaji. (See Raghavan, Venkataraman. Śāhendravilāsa of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa (A Poem on the Life of King Śāhaji of Tanjore, 1684-1710) Tiruchi: The Kalyan Press, 1952: p. 21).
